title: Decentralized Adspaces
tagline: The decentralized version of million dollar homepage. Own a piece of the future.
description: Own a piece of the future. You can buy a piece of the million dollar page and showcase your ADs for life. Unlike Alexander Tew's version, here you can change your ad whenever you want for just gas fees. Showcase videos, images or gifs whatever you want, also redirect your visitors to the main page.
how_its_made:
The smart contracts are built on Solidity, CSS grids have been used to form the responsive grid making sure that they occupy maximum area. The NFT images and description are stored off chain on IPFS using Pinata pinning service. The blockchain is indexed using Graph Protocol.
